basic_info.description: Nestled atop Golden Gate Heights, this exquisite home offers amazing views, while providing convenient access to the vibrant Inner Sunset's world-class dining and local boutiques. The main floor features an elegant, spacious living room with a corner fireplace that flows seamlessly into the dining area. Both spaces open onto a walk-out deck, perfect for enjoying the northern views. A charming kitchen also connects to the dining area. This level boasts beautiful hardwood floors throughout, a powder room, and a laundry room with direct access to the garage. The top floor is home to three bedrooms, including a master suite that captures open green views of San Francisco. Downstairs, you'll find a generous family room and a full bath, with direct access to a sprawling garden. This home is equipped with solar panels and is just steps away from Golden Gate Heights Park, which offers a dog run, a children's playground, and tennis courts. Easy street parking is also available. Vidoe: https://vimeo.com/1104473864
